column3: NASB capitalizes the speaker's pronouns (“Me,” “My”). “Islands” is kept.
“I will get glory” is rendered “I will show My glory.”
“To him it will be gathered” follows the Qere; NASB puts the end in parentheses.
“To despise life” is rendered “To the despised One.”
“I will answer” is rendered “I have answered,” and “to make inherit” as “to make them inherit.”
“Your children” is rendered “Your builders,” following a different vowel reading.
“Draw near for me” is rendered “Make room for me.”
“The captives of the righteous” is rendered “the captives of a tyrant,” following a different reading.
